meaning: tillable or untilled or fallow ground

elsewhere.note: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Yahweh, until he comes and rains…
